gloss: power of attorney; letter of authorization; proxy form

definitions.gloss: power of attorney; letter of authorization; proxy form
definitions.explanation: a written document authorizing someone to act on another's behalf

examples.japanese: {委任状|いにんじょう}を{書|か}いてください。
examples.english: Please write a letter of authorization.

examples.japanese: {本人|ほんにん}が{来|こ}られない{場合|ばあい}は、{委任状|いにんじょう}が{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: If the person cannot come in person, a power of attorney is required.

examples.japanese: {株主|かぶぬし}{総会|そうかい}に{出席|しゅっせき}できないので、{委任状|いにんじょう}を{提出|ていしゅつ}した。
examples.english: Since I couldn't attend the shareholders' meeting, I submitted a proxy form.

notes:
{委任状|いにんじょう} is a formal document authorizing someone to act as a proxy or representative.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {委任|いにん} (entrustment, delegation)
- {状|じょう} (document, letter)

COMMON USES:
- Government offices: When someone else handles your paperwork
- Bank transactions: For handling accounts on someone's behalf
- Shareholder meetings: Voting by proxy
- Legal matters: Authorizing lawyers to represent you

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {委任状|いにんじょう}を{書|か}く (to write a power of attorney)
- {委任状|いにんじょう}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する (to submit authorization)
- {委任状|いにんじょう}が{必要|ひつよう} (authorization required)

TYPICAL CONTENTS:
- Name of the person being authorized
- Specific matters they can handle
- Date and signature/seal of the authorizing person
